audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 6 give Jayce the stage at 2/10 and disagree with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirrored jayce__tryndamere audit set win[4], win[6] and the matching phases sides to Tryndamere. Row 4 the page's own prose already says level 6 favours Tryndamere — Jayce has no true ultimate — so the chart contradicted the text beside it. Row 6 is Tryndamere's because two items on, a champion who has to poke from range cannot answer a committed split.
audit.corrected: Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere — rows 4 and 6 as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; the first-item and late stages were both written as Jayce takeovers.
audit.why: Shock Blast 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 6; Thundering Blow 20s at rank 1; Lightning Field / Hyper Charge 10s; the weapon swap is a flat 6s. Undying Rage 120/100/80s. First item is his poke window; two items on it swings back.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3], late, dosFull[0] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The weapon swap was never mentioned as a combo opener, and its resist shred was absent from the whole page.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon… The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' It is a 6s auto-attack reset that opens his burst and pre-shreds the resists you built — so the swap animation, not the Shock Blast cast, is the cue to step out, and armour alone reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: His weapon swap is a 6s auto reset, and the first hit after it shreds resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] and wants.foe[2] call To the Skies! a ranged E and a kiting tool; spikes[0] calls Thundering Blow a 'Melee W'.
audit.why: To the Skies! is the Hammer-stance Q — a 600-range leap onto a target that closes distance, it does not create it. Thundering Blow is the Hammer-stance E, 20s at rank 1. Acceleration Gate is the Cannon-stance E. A player tracking the wrong stance and the wrong slot commits into a knockback that was never on cooldown.
audit.corrected: To the Skies! is his Hammer Q, a 600-range leap onto you — it closes, it does not escape. Thundering Blow is his Hammer E on 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Acceleration Gate interaction with Shock Blast was stated only as 'poke with Shock Blast into Acceleration Gate'.
audit.why: 'If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' The gate landing on the ground is the tell that the next orb is the dangerous one — that is what you dodge on, not the orb itself.
audit.corrected: The gate going down is the tell, not the orb.

audit.why: Its slow applies only to enemies with their backs turned, so against a champion who kites it punishes his retreat, not his approach — the opposite of how the page's disengage advice reads.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout only slows him once his back is turned, so it punishes his retreat, not his approach.

edits.before: Late game Jayce's burst and Acceleration Gate kiting win the extended lane.
edits.after: Late, your crit split beats a Jayce who must poke from range to matter.

edits.before: Jayce pokes with Ranged Q Shock Blast into Acceleration Gate and can knock you back with Melee W Thundering Blow, so you must use minions to block the long-range Q and only commit when his Gate is down; early trades are a skill test of dodging his poke line.
edits.after: Shock Blast fired through the Acceleration Gate gains range, speed and damage — the gate going down is the tell, not the orb. Thundering Blow is his Hammer E on 20s at rank 1: it knocks you back, so commit after he spends it, never before.

edits.before: Jayce's early-item poke damage (Manamune/Eclipse) lets him zone you off the wave and chunk you before you ever engage; if you fall behind on HP his Shock Blast burst can nearly kill you before Undying Rage even matters.
edits.after: His first-item poke zones you off the wave, and the weapon swap makes it worse: swapping is a 6s cooldown, and the first attack in Cannon form cuts your armour and magic resist before the Shock Blast lands.

edits.before: Jayce scales his poke and burst better into the mid game and can whittle you before any all-in; his mobility with Acceleration Gate and Ranged E To The Skies lets him kite your Spinning Slash and win the extended lane.
edits.after: Two items on you take it back: Jayce has to poke from range to matter, and Undying Rage on 80s at rank 3 buys you the seconds his kite needs. To the Skies! is his Hammer Q, a 600-range leap onto you — it closes, it does not escape.

edits.before: At level 4 Jayce edges ahead with his poke online, but level 6 is your spike window: Jayce has no true ultimate, so if you E in and Undying Rage through his burst you can win a committed all-in he can't cleanly disengage.
edits.after: At level 4 Jayce edges ahead with his poke online, but level 6 is your window: he has no true ultimate to answer a commit. Mocking Shout only slows him once his back is turned, so it punishes his retreat, not his approach.

edits.before: Past first item Jayce takes over again: his Shock Blast burst and Acceleration Gate mobility let him poke you low and kite your Spinning Slash, so all-in early or you lose the extended poke war.
edits.after: First item is his poke window, but two items on it swings back — he has no ultimate to answer a committed all-in. Weapon swap is a 6s cooldown and its first attack shreds your resists, so step out on the swap.

edits.before: Kite your Spinning Slash with To The Skies and ranged form range
edits.after: Swap to Cannon form for range and Acceleration Gate speed

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shock Blast (Cannon Q): 16s at rank 1, 6s at rank 6 — deadlier through the gate. - Thundering Blow (Hammer E): 20s at rank 1, a knockback. - Weapon swap: 6s, and the first hit after it shreds resists.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — commit inside that window.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — walk in only once it is gone.

edits.before: Track Jayce's Shock Blast: His main poke. Dodge it. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: His weapon swap is a 6s auto reset, and the first hit after it shreds resists.

notes: The packet's suspectName is real but understated: spikes[3] wrote 'Ranged E To The Skies', which is wrong in three ways at once — the name drops the exclamation mark, the slot is Q not E, and the stance is Hammer not Cannon. Fixed. Left alone: diff is 'FAV' while tone is the hard-lane red '#ff5d6c', diffRating is 8.5/10 and report[14] says 'Hard matchup', in a lane won 53.93% — the four fields disagree and I did not guess which way the user wants them moved. Also left alone per the mirror: the '5 seconds' duration for Undying Rage in spikes[1], phases[4].why and breakdown.late is not in Riot's text, so no new sentence repeats it.
